reviews.title: This review is for people seeking…physical to e-sim migration
reviews.body:
This review is for people seeking customer support from Lebara. I suggest, simply ask for Indrajeet rather than talking to many others. He knows his stuff. We were struggling with our e-sim migration since 25/9/26 and talked to about four-five customer support staff but we were being told to wait till evening then wait till morning and wait till next morning and next evening, just like that days passed. 
We were so fed up of waiting and wrong advice that On 29/9/26 we dialled customers support thinking that if this time our problem did not get sorted, we are changing our network provider.
But we got Inderjeet that time, he could see what the problem was, he could see that we were not getting any emails because they were bouncing back on their end as well. No emails means no barcodes and no immigration. 
He tried methods after method, new ways after other one failed and after 25-30 minutes of continuous efforts it was done, just like that, no waiting from morning to evening. I was so surprised that how other customer support staff did not know this. So many days in frustration, so much time wasted on the simplest things. I hope it was simple or may be Indrajeet has exceptional skills.
My husband is new to the country and has put this phone number for every single document, application, registration. And having this number functioning was very important else it would be a lot more work to change it everywhere. But at one point changing the number and network seemed much easier than seeking support from Customer Service. But we appreciate that we got to know that highly skilled people do exist in every sector.
Indrajeet, we wish you best of all, and hope you are appreciated at your workplace, you deserve to be appreciated. 
Regards 
Vinod and Yashodha
reviews.author: Yashodha

reviews.title: Horrendous customer service
reviews.body:
Horrendous customer service. I first called Lebara customer service on the 11th of September to ask to be refunded the money they took out of my top-up balance wrongfully. I had been charged for roaming outside of the EU when I was in Greece the whole time.
On the 11th of September I was told I would get a call back from the complaints team in 24-48 hours. I never got a call back.
I then called again on Friday 25th September. I was again told I would receive a call back by the end of the day.
Low and behold I never received a call.

I then phoned again on Monday 28th September and was told I would get a call back by the end of the day again.
And of course I received no call.

I am at my last tether with this company I cannot get through to anyone to get my money back. They make it impossible to actually sort anything out or even complain!

I had another awful experience with their customer service in August where they managed to swap mine and my father’s phone numbers, resulting in a serious GDPR breech. And trying to rectify it and swap the numbers back was near enough impossible - even though it was their fault.

This company has the worst customer service I have ever received. I do not know how I will ever get through to their complaints department.

DO NOT USE LEBARA if you want your sanity.
